fonts.display: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Canopy Green
palette.role: Hero canvas, dark section backgrounds, primary heading color on light backgrounds — establishes the dominant brand surface

palette.name: Coral Pulse
palette.role: Primary action buttons, filled CTAs — the only warm high-saturation color in the system, creates urgency without aggression

palette.name: Indigo Bloom
palette.role: Toolkit section background overlay, secondary brand headings — anchors the purple-lavender pastel system

palette.name: Leaf Bright
palette.role: Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

palette.name: Deep Teal
palette.role: Blue outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Orchid Tint
palette.role: Decorative pink accent for badges, tag chips, and pink-section heading underlines

palette.name: Sky Signal
palette.role: Cyan accent for icons, chart lines, and notification-style data visualization inside cards

palette.name: Aubergine
palette.role: Muted plum for body text on lavender backgrounds and plum-section headings — warm dark that pairs with #460095

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary body text, borders, icon strokes — used aggressively for 1px dividers and outline icon set

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Card surfaces, text on dark backgrounds, nav background, white phone-mockup surfaces

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Mid-gray for secondary borders, placeholder text, disabled list items, icon strokes at reduced weight

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Body meta text, subtle list dividers, caption-tier typography

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Strong secondary text, icon strokes at full opacity, dark borders on light pastel cards

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Headlines on white/pastel surfaces, link text color when not using brand purple

palette.name: Frost Gray
palette.role: Hairline dividers, subtle card separators on white sections

palette.name: Cloud Gray
palette.role: Neutral card surface when no pastel is appropriate, footer background, table stripes

palette.name: Lavender Mist
palette.role: Dominant page background canvas — the near-gray violet that sets the overall atmospheric tint of the site

palette.name: Mint Wash
palette.role: Green-tinted card and section background, pale green data viz fills

palette.name: Sky Wash
palette.role: Pale cyan card backgrounds, cooling counterpoint to the warm greens and corals

palette.name: Sage Wash
palette.role: Very pale green card surface, lighter than Mint Wash for secondary cards

palette.name: Lilac Wash
palette.role: Pale lavender card background, pink-adjacent pastel

palette.name: Peach Wash
palette.role: Soft section background, alternate surface, and quiet card fill. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Cream
palette.role: Warm cream card background, editorial yellow-tinted sections

palette.name: Sand
palette.role: Warm beige background variant, rarely used neutral surface
